description: Hermes Agent through the vendor's PowerShell installer, installed and never launched, found by the hermes-acp.exe launcher it writes under %LOCALAPPDATA%.
why: The idle twin of 107, which launches Hermes before rows are collected; setup.ps1 says why that leaves the installer's own launchers unproved. Nothing is launched here, so require_rows holds the file row to hermes-acp.exe, the catalogued value, as the installer left it.
known_gaps: An install with HERMES_HOME set, or install.ps1's -HermesHome pointed elsewhere, puts its launchers in that directory's bin\, which no catalogued value names, so it is invisible while idle.
